2-9-24
Claimant reported a sideswipe during a lane change and said the other vehicle drifted into their lane as they were
merging. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been cooperative in providing details.
2-10-24
Reviewed photos of both vehicles, which show damage consistent with the described impact. The other driver's
statement matches the claimant's account, and two independent witnesses also describe the collision as reported.
4-17-24
Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash following the impact. Claimant was not entirely
certain of their exact seatnig position at the moment of contact, which I have noted for the file. The injury pattern
appears consistent with the force of the crash.
4-26-24
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy. Searched prior claim history and found no earlier injury to the neck or
upper back. The vehicle's repair history also shows no prior damage to the affected panels.
5-10-24
A neighbor mentioned seeing the car with body damage several weeks before the claimed accident date. I will follow
up by requesting additional information, though this has not yet been verified against other sources.
7-17-24
Claimant has repeated the same account in each conversation with no material differences. Treatment has followed a
typical course and symptoms have steadily improved, with care tapering as recovery progressed.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
